prompt: Gyomyo the crazy card cat holds up a big golden invitation envelope with a wax seal, eyes sparkling and tongue out, overjoyed. Around him: plain cardboard shipping boxes with a simple smile-shaped arrow doodle (not a logo), sealed blank trading card booster boxes, flying blank holographic cards, a little calendar with a circled date and a small hourglass timer. Two tiny flags doodled as simple red circle on white and stars-and-stripes shapes to hint Japan and USA.
